raw_segments.text: After a moment he followed the others in, blinking in the screened light.
The coffin lay on its beer before the chancel, four tall yellow candles at its corners, always
Corny Kelleher, laying a wreath at each four corner, beckoned to the boy to kneel.
The mourners knelt here and there in praying desks.
Mr. Bloom stood behind near the font, and when all had knelt, dropped carefully his
unfolded newspaper from his pocket and knelt his right knee upon it.
He fitted his black hat gently on his left knee, and holding its brim, bent over piously.
